game: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City - The Definitive Edition

findings.name: PS4/PS5 trophy totals
findings.detail: 34 trophies: 1 Platinum, 5 Gold, 9 Silver, 19 Bronze (PowerPyx, Sportskeeda via search snippet). Tier assignment per trophy in gtabase reproduces exactly 1/5/9/19.

findings.name: Four missable trophies
findings.detail: Iron-y (mission Four Iron), Not my First Time (G-Spotlight), Salutations My Little Friend (Rub Out), Chopper'd Up (Demolition Man). PowerPyx says nothing needed for 100% completion is missable.

findings.name: Take the Cannoli
findings.detail: PowerPyx: obtainable from patch 1.02 onward (implies bug/unobtainable earlier).

findings.name: Platinum Kingpin
findings.detail: Requires all other 33 trophies, including Done it All (100% completion).

versionNotes.note: Xbox/PS shared list is 33 achievements/trophies + PS-only Platinum Kingpin = 34 on PlayStation. Xbox has the same 33 (gtabase gives Gamerscore summing to 1000), no Platinum. Names/descriptions are identical across Xbox and PS in sources; only Platinum differs.

GTABase and GameRevolution's leak list 9 further entries (Put 'Em Up: Knock off 15 stores; Offender: Attain 50 wanted stars; Retro Lewk: Wear every outfit at least once; Scouring the City: Find 50 hidden packages; Break it Up: Cause $500,000 in property damage; Target Practice: Land 50 headshots; Prime Real Estate: Purchase all properties; Vice Vice Baby: Complete the Cherry Popper dealer subgame; Baked Distractions: Hijack the tank without alerting the army first, during 'Sir, Yes Sir!'). GTABase describes these as Rockstar Social Club accomplishments, not trophies. They are NOT in PowerPyx's 34-trophy list, so treat as non-native. GTABase's assignment of exactly these 9 as Social Club is inferred.

Tiers on gtabase are derived from Xbox Gamerscore values; PS tiers matched Xbox bands, and the per-tier counts (5 Gold, 9 Silver, 19 Bronze) match PowerPyx totals. Per-trophy PS tiers were not directly confirmed on PSNProfiles (403).
Switch 2 has no native achievements; this is a PS-derived reference list only. No Switch 2 version-specific differences were researched.

gaps: PSNProfiles returned 403 and Sportskeeda 405, so the per-trophy PS tier was not confirmed from a primary PS tracker; tiers rely on gtabase (inferred from Xbox points) and partially on PowerPyx (12 trophies).

City Sleuth tier conflict: PowerPyx Silver vs gtabase Gold. gtabase's set matches the 1/5/9/19 totals, but PowerPyx's own stated golds (Salutations, Chopper'd Up) would then need three more golds, so not resolvable here.
Small description wording variants exist ('30 second' vs '30-second'; 'Find 100 Hidden Packages' vs 'hidden packages'; 'Done it All' with/without period). Punctuation is from PowerPyx.
Did not verify whether the game displays hidden package count or % completion in-game stats (believed yes from original game).
Whether the 9 extra entries are real in-game Social Club accomplishments was not independently confirmed.
Take the Cannoli patch 1.02 note: unclear whether it is fixed on all current versions.
